title: Define release slate and stakeholder escalation path for changelogs
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Context: As Redwood prepares the March console release we need a lightweight, repeatable process to produce both internal and customer-facing changelogs. This ticket defines the release slate (what changes are announced where), roles for signoff, and an escalation path for contentious items or last-minute rollbacks. The goal is to reduce friction between PM, Eng, Design, Docs and GTM while keeping customer communication accurate and auditable.
acceptance_criteria: A templated changelog slate that maps changes to audience tier (internal, beta customers, public) exists and is approved
A clear owner matrix (who drafts, who reviews, who approves) is documented and acknowledged by all cross-functional partners
An escalation path with SLAs (response windows, decision authority) for disputed entries is published
Playbook includes mandatory links to source artifacts (PRs, rollout dashboards, security notes) and a one‑click checklist for launch
At least one dry run has been executed with retrospective notes and follow-up action items assigned
tasks: Draft release slate template (audience tiers, short summary, customer impact) - owner: PM
Inventory current changelog sources across repos and Confluence - owner: Eng
Design a short public-facing blurb template and internal detail template - owner: Design
Define review timeline and approval gates (content freeze, signoff windows) - owner: PM
Create escalation matrix with primary/secondary approvers and SLA windows - owner: PM + Legal
Add links to automation (changelog-builder script) and verify output format - owner: Eng
Schedule dry run with one minor patch release to validate process - owner: PM
Collect retrospective and update the playbook - owner: PM
decisions: Changelogs will be tiered: Internal (all details), Beta customers (selected operational notes), Public (user-facing benefits and breaking notes)
Final signoff for public changelog entries will be PM + Eng lead; Legal notified if content references security, privacy, or compliance
Escalation SLA: 24 hours for product-impact disputes during working days, 6 hours for security/regression claims
We will adopt the lightweight changelog-builder (GitHub action) but keep manual override in Console for curated messaging
notes: Observed problem: previous releases had mismatched customer copy vs release content (support tickets increased by ~18% on 2024-11 rollouts)
